title: Translation torsor structure on the explicit sheafified orbit quotient
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G,G^{\prime}$ abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on its small etale site, $\varphi:G\to G^{\prime}$ and $T$ a $G$-torsor [def-sc-gm-torsor]. Define $P(U)$ as the quotient of $T(U)\times G^{\prime}(U)$ by the relation generated by $(t,h)\sim(g+ t,h-\varphi(g))$, with restriction induced on both coordinates, and $Q=P^{\#}$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Write $q_U(t,h)$ for the canonical image in $Q(U)$. There exists a unique action $G^{\prime}(U)\times Q(U)\to Q(U)$ for every $U$, respecting restrictions, zero and addition, which is simply transitive whenever a section of $Q(U)$ is given and satisfies $q_U(t,h+k)=k+q_U(t,h)$. The underlying sheaf $Q$ is constructed explicitly, not chosen from an existence theorem.

source.place: Tag 03AJ, label lemma-torsors-h1, fibre-of-a-section construction; contracted-product construction from lem-sc-etale-torsor-pushout-extension step 2; torsors as in Tag 03AH

proof.text: Construct P sectionwise by Quot of the antidiagonal generator relation. Naturality of the torsor action and coefficient morphism makes restriction well-defined. Sheafify P and use the unit for q. The module proves the restriction functor laws, naturality and invariance of q, and local nonemptiness by mapping every local section t to q(t,0).

Construct translation on Quot by adding to the second coordinate. Quotient induction proves zero, addition and naturality. Apply existsUnique_sheafify_add_action to extend this explicit operation uniquely to Q, with its formula on the unit images.

For each orbit represented by (t,h), use contractedOrbitEquiv with base section t: translation by k has coordinate h+k. Addition is bijective, so the presheaf operation is simply transitive. Apply bijective_sheafify_add_action to prove simple transitivity in Q. Its unit formula gives the quotient translation equation. To show uniqueness in the original statement, quotient induction converts that equation into the unit formula on all presheaf sections, and uniqueness of the extended action concludes.

proof_origin.note: Complete proof using explicit orbit translation, the existing coordinate equivalence, and two fully proved generic sheafification lemmas. No new holes.
